model.name: U-Net, MobileNet v1 0.25 encoder, round 3 (retrained on round 1 + round 2 answers)

detectionRule: city-wide mosaic; probability >= 0.6; opening 2 px, closing 3 px; area >= 2000 m2; mean probability >= 0.78; < 30% overlap with OSM lots/structures/confirmed lots; excludes areas reviewed in rounds 1-2; outline traced in the lot's own orientation with right angles (rectangle only if >= 86% filled); every outline render-checked
